theory_low.quantum-input-lower-bound-sqrt-m: Theorem 10 (p.6) is proved as Theorem 13, Appendix D.6, p.26-27 (rendered). The printed Theorem 13 and its proof name only Oracle D.1 and Oracle D.2 and say that D.1 is the informative one. By the paper's own definitions D.1 gives traces, which are equal for all j in the two instances, and the hidden a_j* is held by Oracle D.3 (Oracle 1.4). So the printed proof does not establish the value's claim (calls to Oracles 1.2, 1.3, 1.4) without the reviewer relabelling the oracle. The two-instance reduction to Grover search is sound in outline, but that is a repair, not what the paper settles.

Same slip as in the Theorem 10 item.
